name: CasePageInheritedInk
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "page-inherited-ink" (cascade). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: body { color: var(--cf-color-primary) } — the document's ink, inherited by a text-bearing part that declares no colour of its own
